review_type: Independent read-only visual review of actual Blender renders and working turnaround v2
observed_improvements: The broken rear-hair shards are absent in the back and back-quarter renders.
Robe length, loose volume and limb proportions remain broadly aligned with the working reference.
Seven editable objects are available; the raw source is retained.
remaining_visual_issues: Hair is still a thick, complete teardrop/wig-like mass, somewhat wide at the shoulders with a single pointed bottom.
Small hard triangular support shapes remain between the shoulders and lower hair; the right shoulder in the back-quarter view is particularly visible.
Source hands, feet and cuffs remain coarse. Feet look boot-like compared with the barefoot working reference.
next_gate: Review and refine static geometry before committing to UVs, final PixelLab textures or rigging.
